proves.claim: A submitted sprint item the lander merged is offered by the review pick, and an accept on it records verified with the item still landed.

store.io-board-sprint-verdict.landed-spr.why: Without this test the store's verify writer refuses every landed item, so landed sprint work never takes its verdict.

proves.claim: A steady or strict submitted item that already landed still refuses a verdict ALREADY_MERGED and stays submitted.

store.io-board-sprint-verdict.steady-str.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady and strict items.
